fields.name: name
fields.meaning: Title of the text card as shown in the course index and navigation. Optional: Moodle derives it from the start of the intro once, when the card is created without a name. Afterwards the name never follows the intro, also not a derived one. To derive it again from the current intro, set name to an empty string.

value_range.source: mod/label/mod_form.php:41-49 (text element "name", PARAM_TEXT or PARAM_CLEANHTML); mod/label/lib.php:36-40 (get_label_name() keeps a non-empty name)

fields.name: intro
fields.meaning: The text content of the text card (HTML). Shown on the course page.

fields.name: introformat
fields.meaning: Text format of the intro (HTML/Moodle auto-format/plain text/Markdown).
